original_test_intent: Verify that a UCE inside the configured 10% address-range-mirrored region is corrected from the mirror, scrub completes, and firmware-first logging reaches Linux FTrace.
original_method: Record platform and baseline; configure the literal ARM Mirror/TAD/patrol/RAS/debug knobs; halt and prove mirror mode, directory off, ECC on and P/P or ParMirr; enumerate TAD and translate the sample range; only if0x100000300 is mirrored, reset lock, set both device masks0x3 and inject one UCE; read b2cmi1 status/misc raw and decoded; go; enable MCE/RAS trace events and capture extlog_mem_event; restore settings and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates the ARM 10% map, target/B2CMI mapping and register oracle, drives one UCE/go sequence and controls recovery while the agent correlates FTrace and platform evidence.
required_inputs: CScripts version/hash/license plus project BIOS path mappings
Approved ARM Mirror10%/TAD0/patrol-scrub topology and sa2da output
Address0x100000300-to-DIMM/MC/b2cmi1 mapping and B2CMI field oracle
FTrace availability/timing, serial/OOB recovery and knob restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Preserve baseline logs; do not clear away unrelated evidence
Do not inject unless target is proven inside mirrored range and b2cmi1 mapping is approved
One injection only; stop on wrong severity, register mismatch, hang or missing recovery
Restore ARM/TAD/patrol/debug/injection settings and verify memory/OS/BMC health
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved partial-mirror topology and address map
Collect one approved injection, B2CMI and FTrace evidence
Correlate extlog event with controller state
Do not choose target, inject/retry independently or issue PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve ARM mirror recipe and platform paths
Approve target mapping, masks and B2CMI oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Coverage mismatch: dmesg/SEL grep does not establish the 10% mirrored range, B2CMI correction/scrub or extlog_mem_event.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the literal mirror/TAD/mapping checks, both mask0x3 values, one UCE at0x100000300, b2cmi1 status/misc reads, `go()` and FTrace MCE/RAS capture under approval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UEFI ARM Mirror,10%, Patrol Scrub end-of-POST, Mirror TAD0, RAS MID, sample range/address, masks, b2cmi1, extlog and30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove the partial-mirror interval first, inject one UCE at the mapped sample address and correlate b2cmi1 correction/scrub with one extlog_mem_event.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable baseline, explicit path/version approvals, single-attempt interlock and audited restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host logs without TAD mapping cannot show that ARM mirroring corrected the target error.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong range or controller path turns this into an ordinary fatal UCE; platform-specific register and trace timing must be supplied.

project_override_considerations: Reference EDKII paths and compute/socket namespaces may differ; translations must preserve the same knobs and b2cmi instance. ARM percentage and TAD0 layout cannot be inferred from the address literal alone.
expected_evidence: mode.mirror, dimminfo directory/ECC/P-P or ParMirr, addTran and sa2da mapping
b2cmi1 status showing corrected event and misc showing mirror correction/scrub success
Timestamped FTrace extlog_mem_event plus supporting serial/OS/BMC logs
Restoration, post-test health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, 10-step partial-mirror procedure and criteria consistently require a transient UCE corrected inside an ARM mirrored range with B2CMI and extlog evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The mirror recipe, harness and mapping/oracle are supplyable prerequisites, so static readiness is RPUC rather than an inherent block.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row168 Wistron-System RAS-00125-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology, Intel CScripts version/hash/license and project mappings for ARM Mirror10%, Patrol Scrub end-of-POST, Mirror TAD0, RAS MID and serial Normal; provide TAD/sa2da proof that0x100000300 is mirrored and maps to b2cmi1, exact corrected/mirror-scrub fields and extlog_mem_event timing, plus OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Restores address-range mirroring and controller/trace-specific acceptance, preventing a generic UCE log from falsely satisfying the partial-mirror coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Partial mirroring only protects configured address intervals, so the literal address is not sufficient evidence; TAD and sa2da must prove membership and controller mapping for this boot. A corrected B2CMI record plus mirror-scrub status proves hardware recovery, while extlog_mem_event proves the firmware-first notification path. Both are needed because either alone leaves half the source intent untested. Reinjection could create unrelated trace records and is prohibited.
